selection_disclosure: H45 was selected after 41 pilot orders across 40 markets produced a positive point estimate. Every order before evidence_started_at is discovery only and excluded. The rule, assets, market family, thresholds, sizing and execution model are unchanged.
hypothesis: A sustained 30-second change in resolver-spot distance from a same-day strike can reach the executable threshold-token book with a measurable lag after fees and displayed-depth constraints.

frozen_mechanics.entry: bestAction against the executable ask with the pre-existing doubled-fee edge and capacity rules
frozen_mechanics.independence: at most one action per Polymarket market id

evaluation.multiple_testing: Correct across all 135 inspected strategy arms and every post-hoc slice; H45 is not a one-hypothesis discovery.
evaluation.promotion: No live path. A passing read triggers an execution-fidelity and capital-overlap review, not automatic deployment.
evaluation.null_outcome: The discovery profit may be selection noise. Zero or negative forward edge is a valid and expected result.
